summary: Self-update no longer follows upstream pi: the update check reads p's own npm registry entry instead of pi.dev, `p update` always reinstalls @dst0/p pinned to the checked version (reporting a mismatch instead of success) and never uninstalls p to install a package named by a remote response, and update notes come only from the fork's GitHub releases. On p 5.0.2 and earlier, update with `p update --self --force` or `npm i -g --ignore-scripts @dst0/p@latest`, never a bare `p update`.
